question: Will the CBRT's November 2026 Financial Stability Report devote a dedicated box to the 2026 fund liquidations?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: CBRT FSR boxes after a major domestic financial shock. Recent topical shocks have often had boxes (e.g., May 2026 Box IV.5 on financial-market measures), and the CBRT already put out a blog titled 'Fund Liquidations and the Real Sector' on 4 Nov 2026 that could be turned into a box. The CBRT also took measures (interbank limits, collateral haircuts, reserve requirements) tied to fund-market turmoil. Against that: the title must explicitly mention liquidation, the SPK action, or funds in liquidation. The CBRT tends toward neutral titles ('developments in investment funds', 'measures taken'), and it may cover the topic only in Chapter V text because official messaging stresses containment. Net slightly below even. No human market found.
calls.dossier:
- Resolves off the English FSR 2026-II table of contents (Turkish edition if English unavailable). It needs a numbered Box whose TITLE explicitly mentions liquidation/winding-up of investment funds, the SPK's Sept 2026 action, or funds in liquidation. Body-text mentions, or a box titled generically about funds or measures, resolve NO.
- Event window: report scheduled for 27 Nov 2026; as of 2026-11-17 it is not yet published. The CBRT FSR 2026 page lists only the May 2026 edition (fetched 2026-11-17). Annulled if no edition by 31 Dec 2026.
- 17 Sep 2026: SPK ordered liquidation of 131 funds (7 portfolio-management companies, ~TRY 1tn, ~456k investors); liquidation window extended to 6 months on 20 Sep (question background).
- 4 Nov 2026: CBRT blog 'Fund Liquidations and the Real Sector: What Do Firm-Level Data Tell Us?' found ~3,000 firms with TRY 116bn in affected funds (TRY 57bn in money-market funds), ~1.2% of real-sector assets and 0.9% of commercial loans, and concluded impact was limited. Covered by haberler.com, doviz.com, ekonomipolitikasi, tuugo. Blog research is often reused in FSR boxes; the blog's own title uses the word 'liquidations'.
- Governor Karahan (TBMM Plan and Budget Committee, autumn 2026; cnbce, dunya): volatility confined to a limited area tied to individual funds, contagion risk limited, fund market overall sound, >TRY 800bn flowed to deposits, 'will take all necessary additional measures proactively'. CBRT changed interbank borrowing limits, cut collateral haircuts and adjusted reserve requirements.
- 15 Nov 2026 (Simsek via haberler): TRY 161bn paid to 444,987 investors across 119 of 131 funds; no public funds used; payouts via Is Bankasi and Ziraat; SPK stock-manipulation inspections to finish by end-Nov.
- S&P (20 Oct): no financial contagion, household exposure limited. Fitch: risks at securities firms.
- Precedent: FSR 2026-I (May 2026) had 6 boxes, including Box IV.5 on financial-market measures after earlier volatility. Chapter V (non-bank) had no box in May 2026. NBFI share of the system is 26%; investment funds TRY 11.9tn.
- Considerations both ways: CBRT box titles are often neutral/generic (e.g., 'financial-market measures'), and a generic title like 'Developments in Investment Funds' would fail. On the other side, the CBRT has already used 'Fund Liquidations' in a titled publication.
- Searched, absent: any pre-release FSR contents or agenda; prediction markets (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi, bookmakers: none found); readable box titles from past FSRs on shocks (May 2025 FSR PDF unreadable); FSB 11 Nov 2026 Türkiye peer review text (PDF unreadable).

calls.reasoning: A box needs to exist and its title must explicitly name the liquidations. A dedicated box is likely (~60-65%) given the historic scale, NBFI at 26% of the system, a box-free Chapter V and the CBRT's ready-made firm-level analysis. Title explicitness is the crux: the May 2023 earthquake box and the CBRT's own 4 Nov 2026 blog title ('Fund Liquidations and the Real Sector') show it will name events, but the May 2025 post-turmoil boxes used generic titles, and political sensitivity plus containment messaging push toward neutral wording. Net ~0.40.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on all checkable facts; their spread (0.35-0.45) was judgment about box existence and title wording. I searched for any preview of the FSR 2026-II contents (none; only coverage of the 4 Nov blog, which confirms the CBRT used 'Fon Tasfiyeleri' in an official title). I also verified the May 2023 precedent: Box IV.1.I 'Credit Developments in the Earthquake Zone' named a domestic shock in its title, supporting Run 3's precedent. Against this, Run 2's May 2025 generic-title precedent stands unrefuted. With no evidence breaking the tie, I take ~0.62 for a dedicated box x ~0.62 for an explicit title, about 0.40. My own market check: none run; the harness found nothing on Polymarket or Manifold, and the runs reported none.
